name: OpenHabitTracker
tagline: Take notes, plan tasks, track habits
blurb: Take notes, plan tasks, and track habits - native apps on all your devices, plus a web app.
description:
Take notes, plan tasks, and track habits - native apps on all your devices, plus a web app. Free, ad-free, and open source. No account needed: all your data stays on your device.

• Notes with full Markdown support

• Tasks with planned dates, duration and time tracking

• Habits with flexible repeat intervals - track repetitions, time or quantity

• Checklist sub-items on both tasks and habits

• Categories, colors, priorities, search, filters and sorting - for notes, tasks and habits

• Optional notifications: one daily summary of what is due, and a reminder before a task's planned time

• All data is stored locally on your device

• Export and import: Markdown, JSON, YAML, TSV

• Import your notes from Google Keep

• Optional sync: host the Docker image on your own server and every app, desktop or mobile, can log in and sync

• 26 themes with dark and light mode

• Customizable UI - show or hide almost every element

• Available in 20 languages

• Keyboard navigation and screen reader support

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
